messages:
maria: Heads-up — some dashboard examples in the Console docs are failing preview and the cost/latency breakdown text is out of date. I spotted this while testing the KV-prefix dashboard example. PR with failing preview: https://github.com/redwood-repo/docs/pull/842
eng-bot: Deploy preview error: example JSON schema invalid (kv_prefix field mismatch). See logs: `SchemaError: unknown field 'kv_pre_fix'`
sam: I can take a look. Which files are affected? path?
maria: under /docs/console/examples/kvcache-dashboard and the quickstart snippet in /docs/console/observability/cost-breakdown.md. Also the tracehook snippet still shows `trace_id` instead of the new `tracehex` param.
neel: quick note — runtime changed last month to prefer `tracehex` (lower-entropy hex string) and the SDK examples were updated, but docs missed a few spots. Also cost display changed to split tokens-in/tokens-out; docs still show single "tokens" metric.
kevin: can we also update the dashboard sample to use the new columns? current table uses `total_tokens` which we deprecated. Use `tokens_in` and `tokens_out` instead.
maria: proposed small python snippet update (to include tracehex + explicit tokens):
```python
from redwood import Console
console = Console()
console.log_event("render", tracehex="abcd1234", tokens_in=42, tokens_out=128)
```
sam: thanks — I'll patch both python and TS snippets. For the example JSON, looks like a stray typo in the generated example. I'll regenerate with the docs tooling and run the preview locally.
docs-qa: Quick checklist for this thread:
- update snippets (py + ts) to use `tracehex`
- switch doc prose to mention tokens_in/tokens_out breakdown
- regenerate example JSON and validate against schema v2
- fix any dead links in the cost/latency guide
- run preview smoke tests and report results
maria: assigning @sam and @neel as reviewers. @docs-qa can you take smoke tests after PR merge? :pray:
sam: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-repo/docs/pull/855 with the snippet fixes, example JSON regeneration, and a short note in migration guide about `trace_id` -> `tracehex`. Also updated dashboard YAML to use tokens_in/out columns.
eng-bot: CI status: PR 855 — build passed, docs lint OK, preview available: https://deploy.preview/redwood/855
docs-qa: smoke test results: preview renders, dashboard example loads in playground, tokens columns present. Found two copy nits in the migration paragraph (wording around batching). Logged as comments on PR 855.
maria: fixed the copy nits in the branch and pushed an extra commit.
neel: LGTM, merged PR 855. :shipit:
eng-bot: Merged PR #855 by neel — production deploy started (sha abcdef1)
maria: great work, everyone. I'll add a short sweep task to the docs backlog to scan other Console examples for `trace_id`/`tokens` usage next week.
sam: thanks — will follow up with a quick grep and list of files to audit. :thumbsup:
eng-bot: Production deploy succeeded at 2026-03-10T14:22:10Z
